name: colorFabb B.V.
summary: Dutch filament maker operating a dedicated 4,100 m2 factory in Belfeld, Netherlands (opened January 2017) that houses production, R&D and logistics. Known for specialty fill materials (woodFill, bronzeFill, copperFill, steelFill), the varioShore variable-density TPU, and recycled/biodegradable lines. Long associated with the Ultimaker ecosystem.

product_lines.name: PLA (standard)
product_lines.notes: Plain PLA

product_lines.name: PLA Economy
product_lines.notes: Value-grade PLA

product_lines.name: PLA-HP / PLA High Speed Pro
product_lines.notes: Toughened high-flow PLA: 23 mm3/s max volumetric flow, 27.9 kJ/m2 impact strength; exact copolymer/additive undisclosed, so it also has pla-plus character

product_lines.name: LW-PLA / LW-PLA-HT
product_lines.notes: Foaming lightweight PLA; HT variant foams at higher temperatures

product_lines.name: PLA Vibers
product_lines.notes: Decorative sparkle/glitter-effect PLA; base polymer only, no glitter-filled PLA id exists

product_lines.notes: Explicit PLA+PHA blend, majority PLA; distinct from pure PLA and there is no pha id

product_lines.name: woodFill

product_lines.name: corkFill
product_lines.notes: PLA/PHA carrier + cork particles; nearest id is pla-wood but the filler is cork, not wood fibre

product_lines.name: bronzeFill

product_lines.name: glowFill

product_lines.name: colorFabb_XT

product_lines.name: colorFabb_HT

product_lines.name: nGen_FLEX
product_lines.notes: Flexible/impact-modified copolyester elastomer; not a TPU and not the rigid high-speed cope entry - no TPC/TPE-E id exists

product_lines.name: PETG (incl. Economy, Semi Matte, Regrind, rPETG)

product_lines.name: allPHA

additional_notes: No sub-brands: varioShore, allPHA and Vibers are line names inside the colorFabb brand rather than independent labels. No evidence found that colorFabb white-labels for other brands or resells another OEM's filament, so no oem_relationships are recorded; colorFabb does not appear in research/verified-oem-relationships.md. The colorfabb.us storefront lists a New York customer-service address, which is a US service address rather than a second HQ or production site. Whether colorFabb sells build plates or print surfaces was not established (no product found, but the negative is unverified), so makes_plates is left unset. Price tier is inferred from positioning alongside Prusament and Fillamentum; no current per-kg figure was confirmed.

provenance.conflicts: In-house manufacturing is claimed by the company (own factory in Belfeld) but no independent confirmation was found. Price tier is a positioning inference, not a priced observation.
